overview:
NY-07 is a heavily Democratic district spanning Brooklyn and Queens with a partisan lean of roughly 25 points. Nydia Velázquez's retirement creates an open seat, but the Democratic nominee, Claire Valdez, enters the general election with about $1.9 million raised and more than $1.2 million in outside support. Republican Melvin Rivera shows no reported fundraising, and independent Priscilla Ghaznavi has raised about $40,000.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the forecast rests on district fundamentals and the spending picture. Prediction markets price the Democratic nominee near 97 percent. With the seat's deep-blue composition and a large financial edge, the race is rated Safe Democratic; the main uncertainty is turnout in an open-seat year rather than the outcome itself.
